title: Codex initial build
what_changed: First implementation: gateway, detectors, allocator, conformal, ledger, console, eval.
key_result: Reported allocator beating fixed_rate at 40% only; ties elsewhere. Numbers later found unsound.

title: Phase A implementation audit
what_changed: Audit of e88f1c9 written to audits/. No code changed.
key_result: Three fatal findings: eval never called the allocator; corpus circular (10 distinct responses, no-context implied harm at p=1.0); conformal bound violated on finops-agent at 0.298 vs alpha 0.20.

title: Rebuild the corpus
what_changed: Compositional generation replacing 10 templates. Evidence drawn independently of the label; loud and quiet realisations per harm family; clean decoys.
key_result: 552 distinct responses over 3000 rows. Structural leak closed: harm rate 0.164 grounded vs 0.174 unverifiable. Calibrated AUC 1.000 -> 0.81-0.90.

title: Fix the conformal fit
what_changed: Split calibration into disjoint fitting (35%) and threshold-selection (65%) folds. alpha 0.20 -> 0.10.
key_result: Bound now holds on held-out data on all three routes: 0.0485 / 0.0282 / 0.0000 vs alpha 0.10.

title: MLflow experiment spine
what_changed: One run per (policy, budget) in experiment controlplane-r2. Optional; inert without mlflow.
key_result: 24 runs logged with params, metrics, artifacts.

title: Fix cascade bookkeeping
what_changed: A Tier 2 check that already ran could be reported as skipped by the second allocation pass.
key_result: Budget-shock floor coverage corrected from 0.982 to 1.000.

title: Drive the eval through the shipped allocator
what_changed: Deleted the shadow economic_allocator knapsack. Allocator now streams the test set with BudgetController live. Rewrote escaped_harm_rate, audit_coverage and latency metrics.
key_result: escaped_harm_rate split into unchecked (bound-governed) and effective (business-facing). audit_coverage now read from the verified ledger. Latency now measured, not min(900,12).

title: Scenarios on held-out data
what_changed: Removed hardcoded shadow_price=10000/1500, seeded beta-binomial prior, and the two-window budget-shock comparison. Scenario tests split one per scenario.
key_result: Budget shock now a counterfactual on identical traffic: lambda 7.5 -> 30.9, high-consequence spend share 0.64 -> 0.82, floor coverage 1.0.

title: Report the corrected result
what_changed: README and LIMITATIONS rewritten to lead with the weaker, honest finding.
key_result: Allocator averts more at 6/6 budgets but by 0.3-5.8%; loses ROI at the two tightest budgets. Round 1 dominance not supported.

title: Stabilise committed artifacts
what_changed: Rounded stub latency so wall-clock jitter stops rewriting results every run. Added HANDOFF.md.
key_result: docs/results/ now byte-stable across repeated runs.

title: Move audits out of docs/
what_changed: docs/audit/ -> audits/ so pre-submission removal is one directory delete. Stripped audit references from README and LIMITATIONS.
key_result: Verified: deleting audits/ and HANDOFF.md leaves zero dead references, lint and tests green.

title: Repair serving and audit integrity
what_changed: Gateway now calibrates via FastAPI lifespan (it was serving raw scores against invented thresholds 0.55/0.58/0.48). Ledger append serialised with WAL + BEGIN IMMEDIATE. _score_jitter keyed on content not interaction_id. Tier2 escalation reuses Tier0/1 signals. One detection pass in the report instead of three. Policy hash newline-normalised. mypy no longer chokes on numpy stubs.
key_result: Ledger concurrency test: 64 concurrent appends produced 2 surviving rows before, 64 after. Allocator margin at 10% budget 0.8% -> 1.2%. Bound holds: 0.0444 / 0.0215 / 0.0513 vs 0.10. make check clean on a fresh clone for the first time. Demo 31s -> 18s, report 22s -> 15s.

title: Pre-register the paging success criterion
what_changed: docs/PREREGISTRATION.md locks the bar before the work is built, plus methodology guards.
key_result: Locked comparator: baseline wins ROI 2.48x at 10% budget and 4.10x at 25%. Success requires allocator ROI >= baseline ROI at both rows with loss averted not regressing.

title: Multi-claim corpus with labelled harm spans
what_changed: Responses become 4-7 clause paragraphs assembled from controlplane/sim/claims.py. Interaction gains spans; models gains LabelledSpan. alpha 0.10 -> 0.15 (feasible frontier). Four new integrity tests: divisibility, span exactness, harm share.
key_result: GATE PASSED: median pages/response 1 -> 5. 3000 distinct responses of 3000 rows. Prevalence 0.156. Only 3.45% of characters carry harm. Re-derived comparator: allocator averts more at 6/6 by 1.0-5.4%, wins ROI at 3/6 (loses at 10/25/40%). Bound holds all routes at alpha 0.15. NEGATIVE FINDING: whole-response AUC fell 0.81-0.90 -> 0.67-0.76, and page-level scoring on stub detectors is NOT better (hallucination axis -0.17, others neutral); localisation of the harmful clause only 39%.

title: Local Ollama judge + paging-premise probe
what_changed: controlplane/detectors/ollama_judge.py scores a batch of spans in one call (the batching seam a paged scheduler would use). config/judge.yaml holds model/host/seed/concurrency. New `make judge-probe` measures stub vs judge AUC and localisation on a held-out sample. Zero new dependencies (httpx and yaml were already core).
key_result: Model choice measured on a 5-span fixture with a known answer: llama3.2:3b scored 0/5 with the strict prompt and over-flagged every supported claim with the loose one; phi3:mini scored 5/5. Ollama concurrency 4 gave 2.5x (13.3s -> 5.3s for 4 calls). Observed cost ~87s per row (2 calls: whole-response + page batch). Probe on 60 rows running.
